Every component on the validation results screen now has an explanation paragraph. This section defines the rules for how those paragraphs appear and what they must contain.
3.1 — The Display Rule (consistent across all panels)
Below the panel header, above the data content. Shown in a soft-bordered info block with a subtle background — not inline with data.
Maximum 60 words. 2-3 sentences. If the explanation exceeds this in the DB, truncate at the nearest sentence under 60 words.
Direct, calm, operational. Written to the founder. No motivational filler. No generic encouragement. Specific to their actual data.
While Bhudhi is generating (during the research run), show a skeleton placeholder: 3 gray lines, no spinner.
If explanation_paragraphs is empty or the key is missing: show the deterministic template from Part 2 above.
If any competitor deep-field has data_confidence="unavailable": show a small muted badge: "Historical data unavailable" next to that section.
The explanation paragraph is collapsed by default on mobile. Expanded by default on desktop. Toggle with a down-arrow icon.
